Acceptance: Door feedback is readable without combat noise
Pickup confirms weapon and ammo state
Front hit communicates no damage or reduced damage
Weak point is visually and sonically distinct
Effect remains readable during automatic fire
Cyan arc burst and sparks confirm hit

Warning intensity increases with relay health loss

Optional event never blocks main route
Feedback does not obscure objective audio
Pickup is confirmed once and not duplicated
